rules.title: P0: Push Error Budget Burning Fast

model.expr: (((sum(rate(tau_sync_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_sync_operation="push",outcome="error"}[1h]))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(tau_sync_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_sync_operation="push"}[1h])), 1e-10) > 14.4 * 0.001) and (((sum(rate(tau_sync_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_sync_operation="push",outcome="error"}[5m]))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(tau_sync_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_sync_operation="push"}[5m])), 1e-10) > 14.4 * 0.001) and (sum(increase(tau_sync_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_sync_operation="push"}[1h])) > 20)

annotations.summary: Pushes ending outcome=error are burning SLO-1's 0.1% budget at 14.4x over 1 h and 5 m, with at least 20 pushes in the hour. Refusals the client retries (busy, conflict) are not counted.

rules.title: P0: Fetch Error Budget Burning Fast

model.expr: (((sum(rate(tau_sync_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_sync_operation="fetch",outcome="error"}[1h]))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(tau_sync_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_sync_operation="fetch"}[1h])), 1e-10) > 14.4 * 0.001) and (((sum(rate(tau_sync_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_sync_operation="fetch",outcome="error"}[5m]))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(tau_sync_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_sync_operation="fetch"}[5m])), 1e-10) > 14.4 * 0.001) and (sum(increase(tau_sync_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_sync_operation="fetch"}[1h])) > 20)

annotations.summary: Fetches and clones ending outcome=error are burning SLO-2's 0.1% budget at 14.4x over 1 h and 5 m, with at least 20 fetches in the hour.

Fewer than two tau-storage Machines are up (min_machines_running is 2), so forwarded git has no failover. A Machine that is down drops out of fly_instance_up, so the sum falls back to 0 while the app reported in the last day; silent where Fly has reported no tau-storage Machine for a day (an environment without the app).

model.expr: (((sum(rate(tau_storage_operation_duration_count{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",outcome="error",error_type!~"NoSuchKey|NotFound|PreconditionFailed|AbortError"}[5m]) or rate(tau_storage_operation_duration_count{app=~".*storage.*",service_name="tau-storage",outcome="error",error_type!~"NoSuchKey|NotFound|PreconditionFailed|AbortError"}[5m]) or rate(tau_storage_operation_duration_count{app=~".*mirror.*",service_name="tau-mirror",outcome="error",error_type!~"NoSuchKey|NotFound|PreconditionFailed|AbortError"}[5m]))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(tau_storage_operation_duration_count{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api"}[5m]) or rate(tau_storage_operation_duration_count{app=~".*storage.*",service_name="tau-storage"}[5m]) or rate(tau_storage_operation_duration_count{app=~".*mirror.*",service_name="tau-mirror"}[5m])), 1e-10) > 0.05) and (sum(increase(tau_storage_operation_duration_count{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api"}[5m]) or increase(tau_storage_operation_duration_count{app=~".*storage.*",service_name="tau-storage"}[5m]) or increase(tau_storage_operation_duration_count{app=~".*mirror.*",service_name="tau-mirror"}[5m])) > 20)

annotations.summary: More than 5% of S3 calls from tau-api, tau-storage and tau-mirror failed after the SDK's retries over 5 min (a missing key, a lost conditional write and a client abort excluded), with at least 20 calls. Adapted from the W14 draft: tau_storage_attempts_total (per-attempt status) is not emitted yet, so absorbed 429s and 5xx are invisible.

rules.title: P0: B2 Second Copy Over 60 min Behind

annotations.summary: The second copy's recovery point is more than 60 min behind (W13 B5 page line, SLO-6).

rules.title: P0: B2 Second Copy More Than 24 h Behind

annotations.summary: Backstop: the second copy is a day behind, so the copier has missed every page. The primary sweeps uncopied retired packs only after about 30 days (W13 Finding 2).

rules.title: P0: B2 Copier Stalled With Backlog

annotations.summary: Repositories are waiting for the second copy and no copy round copied anything in 15 min. A restarted copier has no outcome="copied" series until its first copy, so that case counts as zero copied.

tau-mirror reported copy rounds in the last day but reports none now, or Fly has a tau-mirror Machine up that reports none. A live copier counts a noop round every poll. Written without absent() so an environment with no copier is silent; a copier gone for more than a day with no Machine left is caught by storage-b2-lag-critical's absence on the dashboard and storage-b2-drill-stale.

rules.title: P0: Manifest Names an Object Missing From R2

annotations.summary: The copier found a manifest naming an object R2 does not hold: possible primary data loss. Stop sweeps and investigate before anything else.
The copier's probe of the B2 destination has failed for an hour, so the recovery point is ageing.

rules.title: P0: Hide Markers Found in B2 (Security)

annotations.summary: The reconciler found hide (delete) markers in the second copy. The copier never hides, so another key wrote them: treat as a credential incident.

rules.title: P0: B2 Lock Extended Beyond 35 Days (Security)

annotations.summary: A version in the second copy is locked more than 35 days ahead, which the copier never does; erased data would outlive the 31-day deadline.

The newest second-copy drill failure in the last 8 days is later than the newest passing drill (D23, STO-1), so a later pass clears it. The failure time is the minute the fail counter rose, less 2 min, so a pass within 2 min before a failure can hide it. The copier exports drill results from mirror_drill_run rows, so the failure survives the drill Machine's exit.
